title: Adoption Lifecycle: Flag Mapping & Renewal State Lookup
content:
Purpose
This is a lightweight working reference for mapping adoption signals to operational risk flags and a compact renewal-state lookup used during QBRs and weekly renewal triage. Goal is practical: one page to orient CS, AMs, and solutions on what to surface in dashboards and what the first line runbook steps should be.

Audience
- Customer Success Managers (CSMs)
- Renewal and Account Executives
- Solutions Engineers supporting escalations
- CS Analytics (for automation)

Quick summary
We convert raw telemetry into 6 normalized signals, weight them, and produce a 0-100 health index. Discrete risk flags are emitted for common failure modes (usage drop, configuration drift, error surge, disengaged admin). The sheet below is intended to be trivially reproducible in SQL or a BI tool.

Signal definitions (raw to normalized)
- active_seats: last 14d unique seat tokens active. Normalize by customer seat_count and log scale. (normalized_active = min(1, log(1+active_seats)/log(1+seat_count))).
- weekly_api_rps: sum of requests / 7. Normalize by account baseline and cohort median (0-1).
- avg_latency_p95_ms: system p95. Convert to penalty: latency_penalty = clamp( (p95 - target_ms) / target_ms , 0, 1 ). target_ms = 200ms for interactive products.
- error_rate_percent: 7d error / requests. normalized_error = min(1, error_rate_percent / 5) where 5% is severe.
- key_feature_firings: fraction of GA feature events used by the account in 30d window, normalized 0-1.
- support_volume_trend: week-over-week ticket volume growth; we map +ve growth >30% to 1, stable to 0, drop to -0.5 (signals likely code push or usage collapse).

Weights (proposal)
- active_seats: 0.25
- weekly_api_rps: 0.2
- avg_latency_p95_ms (penalty): -0.15
- error_rate_percent: -0.2
- key_feature_firings: 0.15
- support_volume_trend: -0.05

Health score formula (pseudo)
health_score = round( 100 * ( 0.25*norm_active + 0.2*norm_rps + 0.15*norm_features - 0.15*latency_penalty - 0.2*norm_error - 0.05*support_penalty ) )
Notes:
- All normalized signals are in [0,1] except support which can be negative. Clip final score to [0,100].
- Baselines computed per-cohort: SMB / Mid-Market / Enterprise to avoid penalizing low-volume product use.

Risk flags and thresholds (emit boolean flags)
1) Usage Collapse
   - Trigger: active_seats drop >= 40% over trailing 28 days OR weekly_api_rps drop >= 50% vs prior period
   - Severity: high
   - First actions: CSM outreach within 24h, check admin changelog, look for invoices/contract changes, open solutions investigation (tag SE).

2) Performance Regression
   - Trigger: p95 increases > 2x baseline OR latency_penalty > 0.4
   - Severity: high
   - First actions: correlate deploys (GitHub PRs), region routing changes, escalate to infra SRE with trace links. Offer temporary model fallback if available.

3) Error Surge
   - Trigger: error_rate_percent > 1.5% and >3x baseline
   - Severity: medium-high
   - First actions: pull recent error samples, attach to tracker JIRA-CS-237, coordinate hotfix or rollback with release engineering.

4) Admin Disengagement (renewal risk)
   - Trigger: admin logins <= 1/30d AND no feature firings for 30d
   - Severity: medium
   - First actions: outreach sequence (email then call), check renewal date and license usage, propose enablement session.

5) Support Fatigue
   - Trigger: ticket volume up 30% W/W for 2 consecutive weeks OR NPS comments trending negative
   - Severity: medium
   - First actions: triage top 3 issue types, allocate SE hours, propose targeted KB updates.

Renewal state lookup (computed column mapping)
- healthy (green): health_score >= 75 and no high severity flags
- at_risk (amber): 50 <= health_score < 75 OR one high-severity flag but recent mitigation in place
- danger (red): health_score < 50 OR >1 high-severity flags OR admin disengagement + renewal < 90d
- churn_alert: explicit cancellation request OR contract nonpayment >30d

Example export skeleton (CSV-friendly columns)
account_id,account_name,cohort,seat_count,active_seats,weekly_rps,p95_latency_ms,error_rate_pct,feature_firings_30d,support_wow,health_score,risk_flags,renewal_state,next_action_owner,next_action_due
12345,Acme Inc,Mid-Market,80,22,1200,320,1.9,0.15,0.4,48,"UsageCollapse;ErrorSurge",danger,CSM-Asha,2024-05-21

Runbook matrix (first 72 hours)
- UsageCollapse: 24h outreach (CSM), 48h admin audit (support), 72h product health call. If no recovery by 72h escalate to AE for commercial outreach.
- PerformanceRegression: immediate SR ticket, initiate tracing and revert plan. Offer degraded model fallback if SLA at risk.
- ErrorSurge: collect error samples, patch candidate in 24-48h, communicate status Slack channel #ops-cs.

QBR talking points mapped to signals
- Adoption highlights: feature adoption rank and top 3 users
- Efficiency: per-token cost and response latency trends (p95) and mitigations taken
- Risk review: list of active flags since last QBR and status of runbook items
- Success plan: enablement items scheduled and milestones to move account to green

Implementation notes for analytics engineering
- Suggested SQL skeleton (pseudo):
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT account_id, count(distinct user_id) as active_seats, sum(requests) as requests_7d, percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by latency) as p95_latency, sum(errors) as errors_7d, count(distinct case when event in ('feature_x','feature_y') then user_id end) as feature_users_30d FROM events WHERE ts >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY account_id
  )

- Compute cohort baselines weekly and store in cs_baselines table.
- Backfill strategy: compute rolling 90d sensors then linearly interpolate for initial 30d of historical accounts.

Dashboard and BI recommendations
- 1-line card: health_score + color pill, last risk_flags, last_action_due
- trend chart: health_score 90d rolling, overlay major deploys and billing events
- cohort heatmap: fraction of accounts by renewal_state per cohort

Open questions / TODOs
- Finalize weight tuning: run grid search across last 12 months to maximize renewals prediction AUC. Owner: CS Analytics (Marco)
- Decide whether to include billing anomalies as separate signal or part of support_volume_trend. Owner: Finance-CS sync
- Define escalation SLAs and add into playbook template for AEs and SREs. Owner: SRE liaison (Dmitri)

References and links
- Adoption signals index: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CS/Adoption+Signals+Index
- Relevant JIRA: JIRA-CS-237 (Error surge catchup)
- Slack channel for triage: #cs-ops-triage

Notes to self
- This is intentionally compact. Extract a 1-pager for AEs and an expanded technical spec for analytics engineering once weights are validated.

End of working draft.
